notes.title: There’s No Santa – Now Available for FREE!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174767/11e8f1eae2bd5e797cfa70b43f1420e42b2699f7.png

There’s No Santa is here to bring holiday cheer to gamers of all ages, and the best part? It’s completely FREE! 🌟

🎮 Search for Christmas-themed items in a vibrant, cartoony world full of festive vibes!

🔍 Features:

 4 festive locations to explore 🎄
 20 items per game from a pool of 60 for endless fun 🎁
 Hint system and zoom feature to find even the trickiest objects 🔍
 Unlock achievements and show off your skills 🏆

Enjoy the holiday spirit with There’s No Santa! Get it now for FREE and start your festive adventure!

Bonus Recommendation! 🎨
If you enjoy relaxing, creative games, check out Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number. With over 100 pixel art images to color and cross-stitch, it’s the perfect way to unwind and express your artistic side.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3071670/Pixel_Cross_Stitch_Color_by_Number/
